law: every verifier change must keep this corpus green; expectations assert raw Issue codes for any registered process and derive from code thresholds plus the vendor standard each check cites. KNOWN-GAP rows hold proven divergences open: they fail loudly without breaking CI and must be promoted when the fix lands.
semantics_note: Overhang code convention: a face trips when angle_from_up(normal) > 90 + threshold (undersides). Formlabs cites 19 degrees FROM HORIZONTAL (formlabs-design-guide.pdf); sla.py implements 19 from vertical, so the code trips undersides shallower than 71 degrees from horizontal while its citation says 19. Wall thickness = inward ray from face centroids; rays fired from hole/cavity surfaces can travel through material and inflate t_max (see KNOWN-GAP phantom-wall rows). Build volume is checked axis-aligned without trying rotations.

fixtures.note: Sealed hollow squat cylinder (outer r20 h15, cavity r17 h9). Internal ceiling is a true downward concave pocket: cupping positive control. Fully enclosed cavity: trapped-volume positive control for both processes. | MJF: Sealed cavity - MJF powder trap.
350x310x100 exceeds the 300x300x350 FDM envelope under every rotation (sorted dims [100,310,350] vs [300,300,350]). Must always trip.
40mm-tall frustum, 0.5 deg wall draft. Below the 1.0 deg IM/die-cast minimum; must trip.
Same frustum at 1.5 deg draft: above the 1.0 deg minimum by 0.5 deg. Pairs with trap-draft-0p5deg as the precision test for the draft gate.
20x20x40 stem + 60x60x10 cap (unioned). Cap underside annulus is unreachable from +Z: true 3-axis undercut, 5-axis warning.

r30 base + r15 upper, unioned so no internal artifact faces. Every downward-facing region is reachable base bottom or the shoulder faces up: no 3-axis undercut. SHARP_INTERNAL_CORNERS fires at the shoulder and is accepted milling truth (not asserted either way).
16 square pockets = 128 sharp concave edges, over both the >=10 (radii) and >=5 (fillets) count floors. Positive control for the floors.

50x50x2mm flat blank: 2.0mm is a standard gauge inside the 0.5-6mm range. Fully clean. | MJF: 2mm plate: all MJF geometry checks clear; aspect 25:1 trips the repo-generic 10:1 WARNING (uncited code threshold, asserted as measured behavior).

0.2mm foil below the 0.3 code threshold. Note the message text says 'below 0.5mm min gauge' while the code trips at 0.3: threshold/message mismatch held as finding F11, not a corpus row. | MJF: 0.193mm foil vs HP MJF DG 3.1 0.5mm min wall - ERROR (>10% faces thin).
Blind hole dia 4mm depth 44mm: ratio 11 > 10. Feature detector must find the hole; trips on detection.
Plain r30 h60 cylinder: symmetric with rotational surface evidence, L/D 2. Turning must be fully clean.
r10 h220: L/D 11 > 10 deflection limit.
r10 h180: L/D 9, under the limit. Boundary pair with trap-shaft-ld11.
100mm solid cube: V/SA modulus 16.7mm, over both the sand (12) and investment (15) thresholds.

60mm solid cube: modulus 10.0, under both thresholds. Boundary pair with trap-cube-100mm-bulky. The 12-vs-15 divergence between the two casting processes is documented as finding F10. | MJF: Clean MJF control: 60mm cube passes every MJF check.

Solid r10 h100 rod containing a sealed dia 4mm x 100mm channel (two bodies). Core aspect 25:1 > 6: fragile-core trip; the sealed channel is also a trapped volume for AM. | MJF: Sealed pipe cavity, powder cannot escape.
60x60x20 block with a 45 deg pyramidal top: genuinely non-prismatic for wire EDM.
Underside 10 deg above horizontal: below the Formlabs 19 deg-from-level minimum, so it trips under BOTH the citation and the code. Hard boundary anchor.
Underside 80 deg above horizontal (10 from vertical): self-supporting under both readings. Fully clean for SLA and DLP.
Solid 10mm cube. Green since the F1 fix (cupping requires concave-pocket evidence) and F2 fix (residual-stress patch floor >=400mm2); promoted from KNOWN-GAP to hard row.

Cup WITH a compliant 4mm drain hole. Green since the F1 fix (cupping requires concave downward-pocket evidence); promoted from KNOWN-GAP to hard row. | MJF: Open cup - not an enclosed cavity; 5mm drain rule does not apply.

F3: underside 44 deg from vertical = 46 deg from horizontal, self-supporting per the Formlabs 19 deg-from-level citation, but sla.py's 90+19-from-up test trips it. The dlp sub-row is HARD and trips: DLP's own cite says 30 deg from vertical and 44 > 30 - the same file proving one gate's convention is cited right and the other's is not. Copied verbatim from trap-corpus v1.2.
F3: underside 30 deg above horizontal: above the Formlabs 19 deg minimum (should pass, citation-true) but inside the code's effective 71 deg band (trips today).
F4: sorted dims [100,200,350] fit the sorted FDM envelope [300,300,350] when the part is rotated, but the axis-aligned zip trips on X=350>300. Orientation-naive build-volume check.
F4: r40 h300 shaft along X. Lathe envelope is (254,254,533): the 300mm length fits in Z, but the axis-aligned check fails it on X. Same file correctly trips SLA (300 > 210 under any rotation).

F5: a uniform 3mm-wall hollow box with a 4mm drain stays uniform after cylindrical-surface radial rays are excluded from wall-stock measurement. | MJF: Sealed hollow box, no drain >= 5mm (HP MJF DG 4.2 escape holes).
F5: a uniform 5mm plate with a 2mm through-hole stays uniform; cylindrical-hole radial rays and isolated long span rays do not redefine wall stock.
F13 control: the 2mm hole clears print resolution; short tessellation chords on its cylindrical wall are not physical small features.

F6: one 20x20x12 square pocket = 8 sharp concave edges. die_casting (floor >=5) fires MISSING_FILLETS (hard sub-row, green today); cnc_3axis (floor >=10) stays silent even though a 0.5mm-radius tool cannot cut the corners. The two floors disagree on the same geometry.

F7: one real 0.3mm rib among ten 5mm ribs must trip SMALL_FEATURES even though it is less than 5% of mesh edges. | MJF: 0.286mm rib: below 0.5mm min wall (WARNING) but above 0.2mm min feature - MJF discriminator row.
F8: polygonized circular boundaries on a detected blind hole do not count as uncuttable end-mill pocket corners; the 2:1 hole also stays below the deep-hole threshold.
F13 control: the 8mm hole clears FDM resolution; polygon chords on the cylindrical wall are not physical small features.
F9: a formed 2mm U-channel stays within sheet gauge even though every bounding-box dimension is much larger than its wall thickness.

60x60x5 plate with r4 edge fillets: fillets are 27.3% of surface area - genuinely non-prismatic for wire EDM (a wire cuts a 2D profile). Retained as a hard TRIP row after F12 re-measurement showed the original KNOWN-GAP premise (prismatic part, wrong verdict) did not hold by area.

F12: 100x100x5 plate, 2mm 45-deg chamfer on one top edge, chamfer tessellated at 200 segments. 98.71% prismatic by surface AREA at any mesh density; face-count metric reports 80.1% here and trips. check_prismatic is area-weighted so the verdict follows geometry, not tessellation.

F12 tessellation-invariance pair: same chamfered plate with the chamfer at 1 segment. Face-count metric reports 87.5% (passes) here vs 80.1% (trips) on the 200-segment twin - identical geometry, opposite verdicts. Area-weighted metric passes both.
40x40x3 plate with ten 2mm ribs + one 0.094mm rib: below HP MJF DG 3.2 0.2mm min feature and 0.5mm min wall.
120x10x10 rod: 12:1 exceeds the repo 10:1 aspect threshold (WARNING); wall and build volume clear.
400x100x100 bar: 400mm axis exceeds HP Jet Fusion 5200 380x284x380 envelope under the rotation-aware fit check.
